notes.title: 🚨 Release 0.55.0 is LIVE! 🚨
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/T6g7KdP.png

Patch 0.55.0 is here!

Featuring:

 New stamina system 
 Removal of physical tackles in favour of contextual shoulder barge 
 Improved interception logic and fewer accidental tackle triggers
 Lowered ground pass speed and capped trap heights for better control 
 Sprint dribble turns buffed, speed up now distance-based 
 Offensive and defensive AI upgrades for better runs and positioning 
 Traditional corner system added or more immersion and to follow standard rules
 Upgraded GK animations and movement
 New Ranked! 


You can see the full list of easy-to-read patch notes on our website here!

notes.title: Global Playtest Weekend! Starting 28th February 2025
notes.content:
The time has come! We're opening the gates of our upcoming game and will host a worldwide closed Playtest this weekend!

How to Register: Go to our Steam page, login, and simply click on “Request Access”

What to expect in this playtest:


 Ranking System – Every match matters as you climb the ranks and prove your skills.

 Golden Boot Leaderboard – The top goal-scorers will be displayed for all to see on our Golden Boot web page. Will you be the one to beat?

 Challenges – Complete special in-game challenges to unlock exclusive rewards.


Deadline: Friday 28th February at 12:30 CET

Request access here! GOALS Steam Page

https://i.imgur.com/pokLS8T.png

notes.title: Release 0.46.0 is live!
notes.content:
Hey GOALS community,

Thank you for being an integral part of our journey to build GOALS! We’re thrilled to share the latest changes based on your feedback:


 Reworked duels to better account for positioning and physicality
 Manual shielding implemented
 Added Drag Back Skill Move
 Improvements to bots, both beginner and intermediate.


Test these updates now and let us know what you think on Discord!
